title: The Heat That Traveled Three Ways
intro: This quiz follows Nina and Omar as they discover the three ways heat moves: conduction, convection, and radiation.

choices: Heat moving through direct contact
Heat moving only through space
Heat moving because warm air rises
Heat disappearing from an object
questions.explanation: Conduction is heat moving through direct contact.

questions.prompt: Why did the spoon handle become warm in the hot tea?
choices: Radiation from the Sun warmed it
Conduction moved heat through the spoon
Cooler air sank around it
The spoon made its own heat
questions.explanation: Conduction moved heat through the spoon, warming the handle in the hot tea.

choices: Warm liquids or gases rise while cooler parts sink
Heat moves only through solid objects
Heat travels through empty space as waves
Heat stops moving completely
questions.explanation: During convection, warm liquids or gases rise while cooler parts sink.

questions.prompt: How did the Sun warm the metal bench?
choices: By conduction
By convection
By radiation
By evaporation
questions.explanation: The Sun warmed the metal bench by radiation.

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly matches all three types of heat transfer?
choices: Conduction uses direct contact, convection happens in liquids and gases, and radiation travels as waves
Conduction happens only in air, convection needs no matter, and radiation uses direct contact
Conduction and convection happen only in space
Radiation happens only in water
questions.explanation: Conduction uses direct contact, convection happens in liquids and gases, and radiation travels as waves.
